name: Emergence of Classes: do classes emerge?
description: Do classes emerge? The tag society from random starts; the metric is the share of periods (over 5000) spent segregated: in classes, or with equity above and division below. AEY show both in Figs. 8–9 at N = 100, m = 20, ε = 0.2; Poza et al. 2011 found 'segregation never emerged' with AEY's rule. Measured (release, seeds 1–20, recorded 2026-09-25): under AEY's rule 0 % at every setting (N 20 m 5 ε 0.05; N 20 m 10 ε 0.1; AEY's own); under the mode rule 34 %, 54 % and 49 %.
